_about: MAIN RUN. The load cell: the worked bundle's ten load-versus-conflict trials and the ten of every hand-written bundle in data/load/, every instruction in one operator message.
qwen3.5-9b on sm80-vllm0280, thinking off (study-nothink). Every main run of every model shares the design, sizes, repeats and tool_turns of its kind; only the model, the mode and the seed differ.
confirmatory is false: the owner decided on 2026-09-29 that there is no pre-registration, so every result of the main run is exploratory, and insights drawn from it are tested on further models.

Run it with scripts/run_trials.sh main-load-qwen3.5-9b-nothink, or every main run of this model with scripts/run_main.sh qwen3.5-9b. The same command resumes. Records go on the operator's branch, never on master.
